Per-call prices the Cloudflare Monetization Gateway charges, from the canonical catalog ([szl-gov `pricing/catalog.yaml`](https://github.com/szl-holdings/szl-gov/blob/main/pricing/catalog.yaml)), checked against the fresh 2026-11-13 Cloudflare API readback, including the current payout wallet, the OPTIONS exclusion and the disabled evidence-snapshot rule.

| Path prefix | Host | Who pays | Price per request | Gateway rule |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `/v1/chat/` (OpenAI-compatible chat) | any a-11-oy.com host | everyone | $0.02 USDC (20000 atomic, exact) | Doctrine chat - Nemotron Estate flagship (everyone, x402) |
| `/v1/completions`, `/v1/responses` (completions and responses on the inference host) | inference.a-11-oy.com | everyone | $0.02 USDC (20000 atomic, exact) | Completions/Responses - Nemotron Estate flagship (everyone, x402) [2026-11-06 leak fix] |
| `/api/a11oy/v1/mesh/`, `/api/a11oy/v1/frontier/` (a11oy mesh and frontier APIs) | any a-11-oy.com host | Cloudflare-verified bots only | $0.05 USDC (50000 atomic, exact) | Premium API mesh/frontier (bots) |
| `/api/a11oy/v1/attest/`, `/api/a11oy/v1/ledger` (a11oy attest and ledger APIs) | any a-11-oy.com host | Cloudflare-verified bots only | $0.025 USDC (25000 atomic, exact) | Premium attest/ledger APIs (bots) |

Not offered yet (no enabled gateway rule, no price): `/mcp/` (MCP tool calls); `/v1/inference/` (model inference); `/api/a11oy/v1/experimental/` (a11oy experimental APIs); `/v1/acoustic/` (acoustic validation); `/v1/data/` (dataset access); `/v1/anatomy/` (Living Anatomy API); `/v1/brain/` (Second Brain retrieval); `/api/v1/evidence-snapshot` (evidence snapshot).

Owner policy (2026-11-06): Charge API and MCP hosts only. Websites, /pricing, the proof site a11oy.net, health checks and /.well-known paths stay free.

Machine-readable copy: https://a-11-oy.com/.well-known/x402-pricing.json. 4 of 18 gateway rules enabled (a-11-oy.com: 4 of 16; a11oy.net: 0 of 2), per the fresh 2026-11-13 Cloudflare API readback, including the current payout wallet, the OPTIONS exclusion and the disabled evidence-snapshot rule.

Limits: Methods: the completions/responses rule explicitly excludes OPTIONS for browser preflight. Other rules export no HTTP method selection, and whether POST requests to these paths are charged is unverified. Origins: paying clears the gateway only; whether each origin then serves a paid caller without its own credential has not been verified. Eligibility: Cloudflare's Monetization Gateway requires buyers and sellers to be based in the United States. Revenue: this catalog records prices, not settlements; it says nothing about whether any payment has settled.
